entries.source:
Mesmer Enchanter armor is an art type available in the Prophecies campaign.

The prestige version of this armor is Mesmer Elite Enchanter armor.



Any dye applied onto the female armor's hose (leg piece) is somewhat redundant as it gets obscured by the attire (chest piece).
This armor has clipping issues at the female footwear.
entries.text:
幻術師附魔護甲是《阿斯卡隆戰記》的護甲外觀。

此護甲的高階版本是幻術師精英附魔護甲。

女性長褲（腿甲）會被上衣（胸甲）遮住，因此替長褲染色的作用有限。
女性鞋子有穿模問題。
entries.reason: 核對一般與精英附魔的對應；hose為長褲，染色被上衣遮住；clipping指女性鞋子穿模。

entries.source: The Mesmer Imposing Mask is an art type introduced in the Prophecies campaign and is also available in the Factions campaign and Eye of the North expansion. This mask is available with a Domination Magic attribute bonus for all masks with lower than max armor rating. At max armor rating this mask can be crafted with all mesmer attribute bonuses.
entries.text: 幻術師華麗面罩是《阿斯卡隆戰記》推出的護甲外觀，也可在《盟與敵》和《極地之眼》資料片取得。低於最高防禦等級的面罩只提供支配魔法屬性加成；最高防禦等級的面罩則可選擇各種幻術師屬性加成來製作。
entries.reason: 核對低於最高防禦僅支配魔法、最高防禦可選全部幻術師屬性的分界，修正campaign與armor rating。

entries.source:
Mesmer Istani armor is an art type available in the Nightfall campaign as starter armor, as collector armor for the region of Istan, and as regular crafted armor. The collector headgear is only available with an Inspiration Magic +1 bonus. 

There is no prestige version of Istani armor.
entries.text:
幻術師艾斯坦護甲是《黑暗逆襲》的護甲外觀，可作為初始護甲、向艾斯坦地區的收藏家兌換，或透過一般製作取得。收藏家提供的頭飾只有靈感魔法 +1 加成。

艾斯坦護甲沒有高階版本。
entries.reason: 核對三種取得方式及僅收藏家頭飾限靈感魔法+1，避免把限制擴大至製作頭飾。

entries.source:
Mesmer Kurzick armor is an art type available in the Factions campaign.

The prestige version of this armor is Mesmer Elite Kurzick armor.



*The female version of this armor has quite a few clipping issues with off-hands and shields.
*The male leggings appear green in the non dye-able areas from a distance.
*The female version of Mesmer Elegant Long Coat seems to be a reskin of this armor.
entries.text:
幻術師庫茲柯護甲是《盟與敵》的護甲外觀。

此護甲的高階版本是幻術師精英庫茲柯護甲。

女性版本與副手物品和盾牌有多處穿模問題。
男性護腿的不可染色區域從遠處看會呈現綠色。
女性版幻術師優雅長袍看起來沿用這套護甲的模型，並更換貼圖。
entries.reason: 核對副手與盾牌、男性遠距不可染色區域；保留seems的不確定性，reskin不譯為重新設計。

entries.source:
Mesmer Luxon armor is an art type available in the Factions campaign.

The prestige version of this armor is Mesmer Elite Luxon armor.
entries.text:
幻術師勒克森護甲是《盟與敵》的護甲外觀。

此護甲的高階版本是幻術師精英勒克森護甲。
entries.reason: 核對職業、戰役及一般勒克森至精英勒克森的版本對應。

entries.source: Mesmer Norn armor is a prestige art type available in the Eye of the North expansion. You need to be at least rank 5 (Slayer of Wurms) in the Norn title track to be able to craft this armor.
entries.text: 幻術師諾恩護甲是《極地之眼》資料片的高階護甲外觀。製作前，諾恩稱號必須至少達到第 5 級（Slayer of Wurms）。
entries.reason: 修正title track為稱號進度，保留第5級門檻及未證實中文稱號名。

entries.source:
Mesmer Obsidian armor is a prestige art type available to players from all campaigns. There is no Obsidian headgear for Mesmers.



* In order for the Eternal Forgemaster to appear in The Fissure of Woe, players must complete the following quests:
** The Eternal Forgemaster
** Defend the Temple of War
** Restore the Temple of War
The female variation of the armor has clipping issues on the back of the skirt & boots during the walking animation, and sometimes in stationary standing positions depending on camera views.
entries.text:
幻術師黑曜石護甲是所有戰役玩家皆可取得的高階護甲外觀。幻術師沒有黑曜石頭飾。

要讓永生的鍛造大師 在災難裂痕出現，玩家必須完成以下任務：
• The Eternal Forgemaster
• Defend the Temple of War
• Restore the Temple of War

女性版本在行走動畫中，裙子與靴子的背面會穿模；靜止站立時，依觀看角度也有時會出現此問題。
entries.reason: 核對三項任務為出現條件及沒有頭飾；保留行走與特定視角站立的女性穿模範圍，任務專名沿用英文。

entries.source:
Mesmer Performer armor is an art type available in the Prophecies campaign.

The prestige version of this armor is Mesmer Elite Elegant armor.



* The female attire has clipping issues with some hairstyles.
* The male gloves have clipping issues with the Tribal Effigy Shield.
entries.text:
幻術師表演者護甲是《阿斯卡隆戰記》的護甲外觀。

此護甲的高階版本是幻術師精英藝術家護甲。

女性上衣與某些髮型會穿模。
男性手套與 Tribal Effigy Shield 會穿模。
entries.reason: 核對Performer的高階版本為Elite Elegant而非同名；分清女性髮型與男性盾牌穿模。

entries.source:
Mesmer Primeval armor is a prestige art type available in the Nightfall campaign.

This armor is only available in the Throne of Secrets, an explorable area only accessible by completing the final mission in Nightfall. If you plan on buying this armor make sure you take all of the required crafting materials and money into the mission with you, as there are no Xunlai Agents, material traders, or rare material traders available in the zone.

There is no standard version of Primeval armor.



* The female top clips between the corset and 'fur'.
* Parts of the armor disappear when underwater.
* Footwear has clipping issues when sitting.
entries.text:
幻術師太古護甲是《黑暗逆襲》的高階護甲外觀。

此護甲只能在神秘王座取得；這個探索區域只能在完成《黑暗逆襲》的最終合作任務後進入。若打算購買，進入該任務前須帶齊製作護甲所需的材料與金錢，因為此區沒有 桑萊專員、材料商人或稀有材料商人。

太古護甲沒有一般版本。

女性上衣的束腹與「毛皮」之間會穿模。
部分護甲在水下會消失。
鞋子在坐下時會穿模。
entries.reason: 修正備料為製作護甲所需而非任務用品；核對通關後區域、無商人與三項顯示問題。

entries.source:
Mesmer Rogue armor is an art type available in the Prophecies campaign.

The prestige version of this armor is Mesmer Elite Rogue armor.
entries.text:
幻術師惡漢護甲是《阿斯卡隆戰記》的護甲外觀。

此護甲的高階版本是幻術師精英惡漢護甲。
entries.reason: 核對職業與戰役，保留一般惡漢至精英惡漢的對應。

entries.source:
Mesmer Shing Jea armor is an art type available in the Factions campaign as starter armor (named Fledgling's), as collector armor for the region of Shing Jea Island, and as regular crafted armor.

There is no prestige version of Shing Jea armor.
entries.text:
幻術師星岬護甲是《盟與敵》的護甲外觀，可作為初始護甲（名為 Fledgling's）、向星岬島地區的收藏家兌換，或透過一般製作取得。

星岬護甲沒有高階版本。
entries.reason: 核對初始名稱Fledgling's及星岬島收藏家與一般製作兩條額外取得途徑。

entries.source:
Mesmer Silken Footwear is an art type available in the Eye of the North expansion. You need to be at least rank 5 (Bold Delver) in the Deldrimor title track to be able to craft this armor.



The female Silken Footwear is a reskin of Mesmer Krytan armor. 

The male Silken Footwear is a reskin of Mesmer Performer armor.
entries.text:
幻術師絲綢長靴是《極地之眼》資料片的護甲外觀。製作前，戴爾狄摩稱號必須至少達到第 5 級（Bold Delver）。

女性絲綢長靴沿用幻術師科瑞塔護甲鞋子的模型，並更換貼圖。
男性絲綢長靴沿用幻術師表演者護甲鞋子的模型，並更換貼圖。
entries.reason: 核對第5級條件及男女分別對應科瑞塔和表演者；reskin保留沿用模型更換貼圖的含義。

entries.source: The Mesmer Sleek Mask is an art type introduced in the Prophecies campaign and is also available in the Factions campaign. It comes with a Fast Casting +1 bonus up to max armor level, and with any mesmer attribute bonus at max armor level.
entries.text: 幻術師高雅面罩是《阿斯卡隆戰記》推出的護甲外觀，也可在《盟與敵》取得。未達最高防禦等級的版本提供快速施法 +1 加成；最高防禦等級的版本則可選擇任一幻術師屬性加成。
entries.reason: 核對快速施法+1與最高防禦時任選屬性的條件分界；up to不能譯成屬性加成隨護甲等級增加。

entries.source:
Mesmer Studded Hose is an art type available in the Eye of the North expansion. You need to be at least rank 5 (Bold Delver) in the Deldrimor title track to be able to craft this armor.



The Male and Female Studded Hose are a reskin of the Mesmer Courtly armor.
entries.text:
幻術師鑲釘皮緊身褲是《極地之眼》資料片的護甲外觀。製作前，戴爾狄摩稱號必須至少達到第 5 級（Bold Delver）。

男性與女性版本皆沿用幻術師優雅護甲（Courtly）的模型，並更換貼圖。
entries.reason: 核對男女皆對應Courtly，與Elegant區分；保留第5級稱號要求，hose是褲裝而非軟管。

entries.source:
Mesmer Sunspear armor is an armor art type available in the Nightfall campaign.

The prestige version of this armor is Mesmer Elite Sunspear armor.



* The collar of the chest piece of female armor has clipping issues with certain hair styles
* The chest piece has clipping issues with the pants visible while running.
* The male Sunspear mask seems to have the same inventory icon as the Costume mask.
entries.text:
幻術師日戟護甲是《黑暗逆襲》的護甲外觀。

此護甲的高階版本是幻術師精英日戟護甲。

女性胸甲的衣領與某些髮型會穿模。
胸甲與長褲會穿模，奔跑時可看見此問題。
男性日戟面具看起來與幻影面罩使用相同的物品欄圖示。
entries.reason: 核對胸甲與褲子穿模並非褲子可見；保留男性圖示比較seems，統一日戟名稱。

entries.source:
Mesmer Elite Sunspear armor is a prestige art type available in the Nightfall campaign.

The standard version of this armor is Mesmer Sunspear armor



* In the image, the male hose and footwear look the same as the standard versions, but the in-game art has been updated. Comparison below with updated versions:
:
The female armor glitches with every pair of hose, including Elite Sunspear.
entries.text:
幻術師精英日戟護甲是《黑暗逆襲》的高階護甲外觀。

此護甲的一般版本是幻術師日戟護甲。

來源圖片中的男性長褲與鞋子看起來和一般版本相同，但遊戲內外觀已更新；來源頁面另有更新版本的比較圖。
女性護甲搭配任何長褲都會出現顯示問題，包括精英日戟長褲。
entries.reason: 修正hose為長褲；核對舊圖與遊戲更新差別，將below改指來源頁比較圖，保留所有長褲皆有問題。

entries.source:
Mesmer Tyrian armor is an art type introduced in the Prophecies campaign and is also available in the Factions campaign and Eye of the North expansion. This armor is called Stylish up to maximum armor level in Droknar's Forge where it is instead called Tyrian armor.

Note: Mesmer Tyrian armor art does not have headgear, but the Animal and Imposing masks are available from the same armorer in Factions and Eye of the North. Pictures and crafting details are available on that page.

There is no prestige version of Tyrian armor.
entries.text:
幻術師泰瑞亞護甲是《阿斯卡隆戰記》推出的護甲外觀，也可在《盟與敵》和《極地之眼》資料片取得。未達最高防禦等級的版本名為 Stylish；在卓克納熔爐取得的最高防禦等級版本則名為 Tyrian armor。

這套外觀沒有頭飾，但在《盟與敵》和《極地之眼》中，可向同一位護甲製作商取得獸皮面罩和華麗面罩。圖片與製作資訊見各面具的來源頁面。

泰瑞亞護甲沒有高階版本。
entries.reason: 釐清Stylish與卓克納熔爐最高防禦Tyrian的命名分界；本套無頭飾不等於同製作商無面具。

entries.source:
Mesmer Vabbian armor is a prestige art type available in the Nightfall campaign.

There is no standard version of Vabbian armor.
entries.text:
幻術師瓦貝護甲是《黑暗逆襲》的高階護甲外觀。

瓦貝護甲沒有一般版本。
entries.reason: 核對職業及戰役；prestige為高階外觀，無一般版本，不是無標準版程式。

entries.source: Elementalist All-Seeing Eye is an armor art introduced in the Prophecies campaign and is also available in the Nightfall campaign. Both have an Energy Storage +1 bonus and are not able to be dyed.
entries.text: 元素使全視之眼是《阿斯卡隆戰記》推出的護甲外觀，也可在《黑暗逆襲》取得。兩個戰役的版本皆提供能量儲存 +1 加成，且都不能染色。
entries.reason: 核對兩戰役版本皆能量儲存+1且不可染色，both不指兩個裝備部位。

entries.source:
Elementalist Ancient armor is a prestige art type available in the Nightfall campaign.

There is no standard version of Ancient armor.



* The male collar clips with long hair styles.
* The female leggings clip with guild capes.
entries.text:
元素使古代護甲是《黑暗逆襲》的高階護甲外觀。

古代護甲沒有一般版本。

男性衣領與長髮髮型會穿模。
女性護腿與公會斗篷會穿模。
entries.reason: 修正clips為穿模；分清男性衣領長髮與女性護腿斗篷兩項問題。

entries.source:
About Elementalist Ascalon armor; for the Factions variant, see Elementalist Shing Jea armor.

Elementalist Ascalon armor is an art type introduced in the Prophecies campaign as starter armor (named Apprentice's) and is also available in the Factions campaign

There is no prestige version of this armor.
entries.text:
本文介紹元素使阿斯卡隆護甲；《盟與敵》的變體見元素使星岬護甲。

元素使阿斯卡隆護甲是《阿斯卡隆戰記》推出的初始護甲外觀，初始版本名為 Apprentice's，也可在《盟與敵》取得。

此護甲沒有高階版本。
entries.reason: 核對阿斯卡隆與星岬的跨戰役變體指引，保留初始名稱Apprentice's與沒有高階版本。

entries.source:
Elementalist Asuran armor is a prestige art type available in the Eye of the North expansion. You need to be at least rank 5 (Not Too Annoying) in the Asura title track to be able to craft this armor.



* This armor is similar to the Elite Iceforged armor
A red mark is visible near the steel parts when a contrasting dye is applied. It is not visible if graphic quality settings are increased to maximum or near maximum.
The male armor clips down at the hem of the jacket when running.
entries.text:
元素使阿蘇拉護甲是《極地之眼》資料片的高階護甲外觀。製作前，阿蘇拉稱號必須至少達到第 5 級（Not Too Annoying）。

此護甲與精英冰法師護甲相似。
染上對比鮮明的顏色時，鋼製部件附近會出現紅色痕跡；將畫質提高至最高或接近最高時，此痕跡便不可見。
男性版本奔跑時，外套下襬會穿模。
entries.reason: 核對第5級門檻；保留對比染色與高畫質消除紅痕的條件，穿模位置是外套下襬。

entries.source:
Elementalist Canthan armor is an art type available in the Factions campaign as collector armor for the region of Kaineng City and as regular crafted armor.

The prestige version of this armor is Elementalist Elite Canthan armor.



Elementalist Exquisite Leggings use the same mesh as this armor.
entries.text:
元素使凱珊護甲是《盟與敵》的護甲外觀，可向凱寧城地區的收藏家兌換，也可透過一般製作取得。

此護甲的高階版本是元素使精英凱珊護甲。

元素使敏銳護腿與此護甲的護腿使用相同的模型網格。
entries.reason: 核對兩種取得方式及凱寧城收藏家範圍；mesh指模型網格，不是網路。

entries.source:
Elementalist Elite Canthan armor is a prestige art type available in the Factions campaign.

This armor is only available in the Divine Path, an explorable area only accessible by completing Imperial Sanctum. If you plan on buying this armor make sure you take all of the required crafting materials and money into the mission with you, as there are no Xunlai Agents, material traders, or rare material traders available in the zone.

The standard version of this armor is Elementalist Canthan armor.




*There is a clipping issue with the female armor - a small triangular group of pixels on the leggings may show skin through the armor near the left hand. The clipping disappears when the emote "/attention" is applied.
entries.text:
元素使精英凱珊護甲是《盟與敵》的高階護甲外觀。

此護甲只能在 神聖之路 取得；這個探索區域只能在完成 帝國聖所 後進入。若打算購買，進入該合作任務前須帶齊製作護甲所需材料與金錢，因為此區沒有 桑萊專員、材料商人或稀有材料商人。

此護甲的一般版本是元素使凱珊護甲。

女性版本有穿模問題：左手附近的護腿有一小塊三角形像素區域，可能會露出皮膚。使用 /attention 表情動作後，此穿模會消失。
entries.reason: 核對任務後區域與備料時機；保留女性左手附近的護腿、偶發露膚及/attention消除條件。

entries.source:
Elementalist Elite Flameforged armor is a prestige art type available in the Prophecies campaign.

The standard version of this armor is Elementalist Flameforged armor.



* This armor is labeled Granite Citadel Elite Armor in the "Resilience" monument in the Hall of Monuments.
entries.text:
元素使精英火法師護甲是《阿斯卡隆戰記》的高階護甲外觀。

此護甲的一般版本是元素使火法師護甲。

在史蹟殿堂的「Resilience」紀念碑中，此護甲標示為 Granite Citadel Elite Armor。
entries.reason: 核對一般與精英火法師對應；保留史蹟殿堂完整標籤，不將Armor譯為防禦屬性。

entries.source:
Elementalist Elite Iceforged armor is a prestige art type available in the Prophecies campaign.

The standard version of this armor is Elementalist Iceforged armor.



* This armor is labeled Granite Citadel Exclusive Armor in the "Resilience" monument in the Hall of Monuments.
* The crystal elements of this armor have a glass-like reflective property, and is the main item modifiable by dye application.
entries.text:
元素使精英冰法師護甲是《阿斯卡隆戰記》的高階護甲外觀。

此護甲的一般版本是元素使冰法師護甲。

在史蹟殿堂的「Resilience」紀念碑中，此護甲標示為 Granite Citadel Exclusive Armor。
護甲的水晶部分具有類似玻璃的反光效果，也是染色主要改變的部分。
entries.reason: 核對Exclusive標籤；可染色的主要部分是水晶構件，非可修改的主要物品。

entries.source:
Elementalist Elite Kurzick armor is a prestige art type available in the Factions campaign.

The standard version of this armor is Elementalist Kurzick armor.



* The streamers on the back of the shoulders of the female version of this armor will clip through the top of the character's guild cape while the cape is displayed.
* The female version of this armor has a small clipping bug on the shoulders at certain angles or when the character moves for certain animations such as pouting.
* The female version clips with the Bandana headgear.
* The male version becomes deformed during the character's idle animation.

entries.text:

此護甲只能在神秘王座取得；這個探索區域只能在完成《黑暗逆襲》的最終合作任務後進入。若打算購買，進入該任務前須帶齊製作護甲所需材料與金錢，因為此區沒有桑萊專員、材料商人或稀有材料商人。

太古護甲沒有一般版本。
entries.reason: 核對終關後取得區域與備料時機；不是任務所需材料，無一般版。

entries.source:
The Bandana is a prestige headgear art available in the Eye of the North expansion. You need to be at least rank 5 (Bold Delver) in the Deldrimor title track to be able to craft this armor. It has an Item's Attribute +1 bonus.



* Sometimes the ties of the bandana have clipping issues with neck pieces of armor.

There are clipping issues with the Bandana and three different male armors: warrior monument, necromancer asuran, and mesmer norn. In addition, there are stretching errors with the necromancer dance emote.
entries.text:
Bandana 是《極地之眼》資料片的高階頭飾外觀。製作前，戴爾狄摩稱號必須至少達到第 5 級（Bold Delver）。它提供「Item's Attribute +1」加成。

頭巾繫帶有時會與護甲頸部部件穿模。
此頭飾搭配三套男性護甲時會穿模：戰士紀念碑、死靈法師阿蘇拉及幻術師諾恩護甲。此外，死靈法師使用跳舞表情動作時會出現拉伸錯誤。
entries.reason: 核對Deldrimor第5級、三套男性護甲及死靈跳舞拉伸；保留Item's Attribute標籤，不臆定屬性。

entries.source:
Chaos Gloves are a prestige glove art available in the Eye of the North expansion. You need to be at least rank 5 (Bold Delver) in the Deldrimor title track to be able to craft this armor.




* Similar to all Mesmer gloves, the Mesmer Chaos Gloves only come up to the wrist.
* If you use an Expert Salvage Kit on the gloves, they will salvage into one of the following:
** 30-40 Piles of Glittering Dust, 2-3 Globs of Ectoplasm
** 25-39 Globs of Ectoplasm
** Piles of Glittering Dust.

=== Coloring notes ===
* When dyed certain colors, there is an extension of the glow from the hand for some female characters.
* Part of the glow is generated through post-processing effects, which many people turn off (either because their system performs better or to avoid changes to the screen as a result being drunk).
* Black (and to a lesser extent silver) dye can dim the glow of the gloves by decreasing the distance of the colored aura from the arm (the color of the arm does not change).
When Chaos Gloves are viewed through a semi-transparent surface, such as in water or under an Ooze, they disappear, making your character appear to not have hands.
If a character cycles between their chaos gloves and another pair of gloves at a semi-fast rate, the chaos gloves will appear with an orange shaded-in box around them for a few milliseconds.
entries.text:
Chaos Gloves 是《極地之眼》資料片的高階手套外觀。製作前，戴爾狄摩稱號必須至少達到第 5 級（Bold Delver）。

與其他幻術師手套一樣，幻術師版本的 Chaos Gloves 只覆蓋到手腕。
使用專業拆解工具拆解手套，可獲得以下其中一種結果：
• 30–40 份閃爍之土及 2–3 顆心靈之玉。
• 25–39 顆心靈之玉。
• 閃爍之土。

染色備註：
某些女性角色將手套染成特定顏色後，手部光暈會向外延伸。
部分光暈由後處理效果產生；許多玩家為提高系統效能，或避免醉酒造成畫面變化，而關閉後處理效果。
黑色染料會使彩色光暈更靠近手臂，讓光芒變暗；銀色染料也有較輕微的相同效果。手臂本身的顏色不會改變。
透過水面或 Ooze 下方等半透明表面觀看時，Chaos Gloves 會消失，讓角色看起來像沒有雙手。
以稍快的速度在 Chaos Gloves 與另一雙手套間反覆切換時，Chaos Gloves 周圍會短暫出現橙色填色方框，持續數毫秒。
entries.reason: 逐項保留三種拆解結果及30–40/2–3/25–39數量，不增加機率；材料用詞庫名，核對後處理、黑銀染色、透明面與快速切換顯示。

entries.source:
Highlander Woad is a prestige headgear art available in the Eye of the North expansion. You need to be at least rank 5 (Slayer of Wurms) in the Norn title track to be able to craft this armor. It has an Item's Attribute +1 bonus.




* All characters will have the left side of their face dyed white while wearing this item, depending on your skin tone. Females have the left side of their face whiter.
* Certain character faces have a little strip of the color dye on the un-dyed side of the face.
* Depending upon your character's face, your eyebrows may be hidden while wearing this item.
entries.text:
Highlander Woad 是《極地之眼》資料片的高階頭飾外觀。製作前，諾恩稱號必須至少達到第 5 級（Slayer of Wurms）。它提供「Item's Attribute +1」加成。

所有角色佩戴時，左半邊臉都會呈白色，白色程度依膚色而異；女性的左半邊臉更白。
某些角色臉型在未染色的半邊臉上，會出現一小條所用染料的顏色。
依角色臉型而定，佩戴後眉毛可能會被遮住。
entries.reason: 核對Norn第5級與Item's Attribute標籤；保留左臉、膚色/性別差異、另一半臉染色細條與眉毛遮蔽條件。
